_schema_documentation.overview: This database stores curated, everyday whole foods with standardized culinary portions and 100g edible-basis nutrient profiles. Follow the schema rules below when adding or modifying entries.

id.description: Unique identifier for the food item.

title.description: User-friendly culinary title displayed in the app UI.
title.rules: Strictly 28 characters or fewer. Use Title Case.
title.example: Eggs Whole, Rolled Oats, Greek Yogurt

description.description: Short culinary note describing the variety, culinary form, and preparation/cooking state.

isCommon.description: Set to true for staple everyday household foods easily measured and logged; false for specialty or niche ingredients.

useCommonScale.description: Controls whether the app prompts the user to log this food via discrete unit scales (e.g., whole count) vs directly in grams (weight).

guidelines.true: Use when the food has naturally discrete, standardized, and unambiguous units that users intuitively count (e.g., Eggs, Whole Bananas, Apples, Slices of Bread, Standard Supplement Scoops).
guidelines.false: Use when common units are subjective, variable, or easily misjudged (e.g., '1 cup of cooked rice', '1 glass of milk', '1 bowl of lentils', '1 handful of nuts', leafy greens, oils). For these foods, the app defaults to direct gram/ml measurements to avoid measurement errors.

protein_index.rules: 1 = Complete protein source (supplies all 9 essential amino acids in adequate proportions, e.g. eggs, dairy, meat, soy). 0 = Incomplete or non-primary protein source.

basis.description: Standard reference baseline against which all values in the 'nutrients' object are measured.

properties.unit: String - 'g' for solid foods or 'ml' for liquids.

common_scale.description: List of familiar household serving units (e.g. sizes, cups, scoops, spoons).

item_properties.label: String - Household measurement name WITHOUT the number prefix (e.g., 'Large egg', 'Medium banana', 'Cup chopped', 'Scoop').
item_properties.isDefault: Boolean - Set to true for exactly ONE primary household scale per food item; false for all other scales.
item_properties.portion: Number (grams) - Total gross weight as served/purchased, including non-edible parts like peel, shell, or bone.
item_properties.edible_portion: Number (grams) - Net edible weight actually consumed without shell, peel, stone, or bone. Used by the app to calculate nutrient intake.

nutrients.description: Complete nutrient breakdown strictly normalized per 100g of edible portion (as defined in 'basis'). All values must be numbers.

unit_reference.macros_and_lipids: grams (g) -> total_protein, carbohydrate, total_fiber, total_fat, water, saturated_fat, monounsaturated_fat, polyunsaturated_fat, trans_fat, linoleic_acid_omega_6, alpha_linolenic_acid_omega_3, epa, dha
unit_reference.minerals_mg: milligrams (mg) -> calcium, iron, magnesium, phosphorus, potassium, sodium, zinc, manganese
unit_reference.vitamins_mg: milligrams (mg) -> vitamin_e, vitamin_c, thiamin (B1), riboflavin (B2), niacin (B3), pantothenic_acid (B5), vitamin_b6
unit_reference.vitamins_mcg: micrograms (µg) -> vitamin_a (µg RAE), vitamin_d, vitamin_k, folate (µg DFE), vitamin_b12
